question: According to the Census of India 2011, which state of India has the highest Hindu population percentage of the total population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the **Census of India 2011**, the total population of **Himachal Pradesh** was 6,864,602, out of which** 95.17% were Hindus.**
 
• This means that almost **6.5 million people** in Himachal Pradesh follow Hinduism.
 
• The state of Himachal Pradesh is located in the **northern part of India** and is known for its scenic beauty, snow-capped mountains, and rich cultural heritage.
 
• Hinduism is the dominant religion in Himachal Pradesh, and there are several **ancient temples and shrines** dedicated to various Hindu deities in the state.
 
• Other major religions in Himachal Pradesh include **Buddhism, Islam, and Sikhism**, but they have a much smaller following as compared to Hinduism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the Census of India 2011, the total population of **Chhattisgarh** was 25,545,198, out of which** 93.25%** were Hindus.

 
 
• This means that almost** 23.8 million people** in Chhattisgarh follow Hinduism.
 
 
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, the total population of **Odisha **was 41,974,218, out of which **94.35%** were Hindus.
 
 
• This means that almost **39.6 million people** in Odisha follow Hinduism.
 
 
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, the total population of **Madhya Pradesh** was 72,626,809, out of which **90.89%** were Hindus.
 
 
• This means that almost **66 million people** in Madhya Pradesh follow Hinduism.
